resources.string: Please note that you CAN\'T watch, stream or download shows and movies with this app.\n\nUse apps like Netflix to stream and watch content.
Language can always be changed later via Settings.

This app uses your own TMDB key, so no key is shipped inside it and your usage is not shared with anyone else.\n\nCreate a free account at themoviedb.org/settings/api, then copy the API key (v3 auth) from Settings → API and paste it below. You can change it later in Settings.

An OMDb key adds IMDb, Metascore and Rotten Tomatoes ratings to show and movie details. Everything else works without it.\n\nGet a free key at omdbapi.com/apikey.aspx and paste it below, or skip this and add it later in Settings.
Shelfly can tell you when a new episode of a show you follow airs, and when a film you are waiting for is released.\n\nYou can change this at any time in Settings.

Shelfly can back your collection up to your own WebDAV server, so the same progress follows you onto another device. Nothing is sent anywhere else.\n\nIf you already sync from another device, setting up the same server here restores that collection.
